events.title: The First Bench
events.description: Shri Ashok Kumar Bansal opens a single-bench retail outlet in Malviya Nagar, working alongside his sons and creating jewellery to order for a select handful of families.

events.title: Manufacturing Brought Fully In-House
events.description: The house strengthens its commitment to craftsmanship by bringing manufacturing fully in-house, with its own manufacturing facility in Mumbai, giving the family greater control over the making, finishing and quality of every piece.

events.title: Expanding Our Presence in the United States
events.description: The house extends its presence beyond India, establishing its reach in the United States and building relationships with clients across borders while carrying forward the same standards of trust, craftsmanship and personal service.

events.title: A New Chapter
events.description: The house continues to grow while remaining firmly rooted in the principles on which it was founded: craftsmanship, integrity, transparency and long-standing relationships.

events.title: The Showroom Is Rebuilt
events.description: The showroom is rebuilt with grey Italian marble, black marble walls, nine seating areas and a private cabin — creating a more considered setting for private consultations and bespoke work.

events.title: Thirty Years
events.description: Many of the families who came in the first decade now bring their children.
